construction.method: AREX scope/ground/construct/verify and repository evidence/usability methods adapted to InferRSI native owners and packaging; no DisCo runtime or managed import.

applicability.scope: Pinned Flare complete-session restore and admission audit for its NVIDIA SM120/SM121 research prototype. CUDA catalog scope is content classification, not device or backend qualification.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to package/source identity and bounded restore traces, with preparation compatibility established before cache-state diagnosis. Running, freeing resources or changing configuration requires separate authority.
applicability.input_contract: Execution ABI and prepared-contract version, ordinary/speculative configuration, model/layout identity, request IDs and consumed-token endpoints, GPU/host prefixes, continuation row, ticket/waiter identities, transfer events, fences and resource counts.
applicability.produced_artifact: A checkpoint/ticket ownership table, five-outcome admission ledger and diagnosis identifying the earliest unsupported transition and smallest missing observation.
applicability.failure_modes: A KV-only lookup hit can omit continuation state; admission can be mistaken for actual reuse; client cancellation can be mistaken for transfer completion; mixing absolute timestamps from client and native clocks can corrupt the diagnosis.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop with an unresolved edge when package identity, layout, transfer completion or clock provenance is unknown.

limitations: Source-only candidate; native Flare/model/GPU/service and skill efficacy were not evaluated.
GDS/Direct transport is deferred and explicitly rejected by the pinned implementation.
Multi-rank source branches do not establish multi-GPU, multi-host or hardware failure qualification.
Root Apache-2.0 attribution does not grant model, asset or separately licensed dependency rights.
Only the selected symbols/sections were inspected; kernels, exporter implementation and whole-repository behavior are outside coverage.
recommendations: Pair the immutable KV parent chain with the complete continuation row at the same consumed-token endpoint before calling a checkpoint restorable.
Distinguish lookup outcomes, destination reservation, ticket creation, transfer completion, publication and actual reused-token evidence.
Follow scheduler-owned tickets through waiter cancellation and check write/use fences before allowing storage reuse.
